topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following shall not be a part of the annual report of a company which is not a Govt. company?

I. Auditor's Report
II. Director's report
III. CAG Report
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with the IRDAI circular prescribing maximum agency and brokerage commission, the maximum brokerage permissible for Marine hull business is:-
e: Correct answer: 12.5% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Total depreciation on any asset cannot exceed its _____________.
e: Correct answer: Depreciable Value (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are correct with regards to preparation of financial statements of insurance companies in accordance with IRDAI regulations?

I. An insurer carrying on life insurance business shall comply with the requirements of Schedule A
II. An insurer carrying on general insurance business shall comply with the requirements of Schedule B
III. The report of the auditors on the financial statements of every insurer and reinsurer shall be in conformity with the requirements of Schedule C
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Statutory audit is only concerned with the propriety and validity of the transaction for the purpose and the maximum profitability of the entity. Argue.
o: Correct as statutory audit is a thorough examinati
e: Correct answer: No. This is totally wrong (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI (General Insurance - Reinsurance) Regulations, 2000, within ________ of the commencement of the financial year, every insurer shall file with the Authority a photocopy of every reinsurance treaty slip and excess of loss cover note in respect of that year.
e: Correct answer: 30 days (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Proposed dividend is to be shown on the liability side of Balance Sheet under which head?
e: Correct answer: Provisions (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In the financial statements of a general insurance company, premium received in advance will be shown in balance sheet under ____________.
e: Correct answer: Current liabilities (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The requirement for disclosure of significant accounting policies followed by a company in preparing and presenting financial statements is contained in which Accounting Standard?
e: Correct answer: AS - 1 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: For the purpose of compliance of the Accounting Standards, enterprises in India are classified into three categories. Which one of the following is not a features of Level I enterprise?
o: Enterprises, whose equity or debt securities are l
Entities whose total turnover during the previous
Entities whose total borrowings including public deposits during previous year are in excess of Rs. 5 crores but within Rs.10-crores
e: Correct answer: Entities whose total borrowings including public deposits during previous year are in excess of Rs. 5 crores but within Rs.10-crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What does the debit column of discount account in a triple column cash book indicate?
e: Correct answer: Expense (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What is the basis adopted as per AS 15 with regards to a liability for employee benefits to be paid in future, provision for leave encashment, gratuity, pensions, and termination benefits such VRS etc. payable to the employees on superannuation?
e: Correct answer: Actuarial basis (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: This method is chosen for machines where productivity is relevant in their performance and in the case of machines with high cost. Depreciation is charged for on the basis of number of hours for which any particular machine is utilized in the production process. Which method of depreciation is this?
e: Correct answer: Machine Hour Rate Method (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statement/s is / are true about the accounting policies to be followed by general insurance companies as per the AS-11?

I. The assets and liabilities, both monetary and non-monetary of the non-integral foreign operations are translated at the closing rate
II. Income and expense items of the non-integral foreign operations are translated at the average exchange rate of the year
III. Depreciation on fixed assets held in foreign branches and agencies is provided on Cost of acquisition.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is authorised body for regulation of the profession of accountancy in India?
o: ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
Institute of Costs and Works Accountants of India
Institute of Companies Secretaries of India (ICSI)
e: Correct answer: ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India) (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Identify the type of reinsurance agreement where the reinsurer has the right to decide to choose risks on an individual basis.
e: Correct answer: Facultative reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The bank statement shows an overdrawn balance of Rs.2,000. A cheque of Rs.500 drawn in favour of Mehta Trading has not yet been presented for payment. When the cheque is presented for payment by Mehta Trading, the bank balance will be:
e: Correct answer: Rs.2,500 (overdrawn) (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ABC Ltd is a trading company, which sells goods on retail basis. Its gross profit ratio is 20% on net sales. From the following figures for the year-end 2013-14 compute the estimated cost of the inventory on the closing date; Opening Stock Rs. 500,000;  Purchases Rs. 360,0000;  Purchase Returns Rs. 100,000; Freight Inwards Rs. 100,000;  Gross Sales Rs. 45,00,000 ;  Sales Returns Rs. 112500; Carriage Outwards Rs. 50,000
e: Correct answer: Rs.5,90,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is closely related to the matching concept?
e: Correct answer: Accrual concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Identify the reinsurance accounting system in which premiums and losses are recorded in the accounts according to treaty terms for the relevant year of occurrence with breakdown of losses by year of occurrence.
e: Correct answer: Occurrence year system (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: __________ is a bond issued by a company under its seal acknowledging its debt and obligation for repayment along with the conditions and provisions for repayment of the principal amount and interest.
e: Correct answer: Debenture (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following accounting standards is not applicable to general insurance companies?

I. Accounting for government grants
II. Accounting for investments
III. Accounting for borrowing costs
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Under the diminishing balance method, depreciation is calculated on which value of the assets?
o: On value given by a valuer
Cost of the asset less the installing expenses
e: Correct answer: On book value (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is not a correct expression of the accounting equation?
e: Correct answer: Net Assets  equals  Liabilities + Equities (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: There is an adverse remark in the auditor's report of X ltd. State the most appropriate document in which the directors need to furnish clarification on the same.
e: Correct answer: Addendum to Director's report (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The Board of Directors of ABC ltd. Have approved an investment policy. Who is responsible to implement this investment policy?
e: Correct answer: Investment Committee (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In respect of coinsurance business where the company is not the leader, provision for outstanding claims has to be made for:
o: Its share as intimated by the leader
Its share and the coinsurers share
Its share and 50% of the coinsurers share
e: Correct answer: Its share as intimated by the leader (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: From the following data of a fire insurance company calculate the Net commission to be showed in the Revenue Account Commission paid - Rs. 3,15,000 Commission on reinsurance ceded -  Rs. 78,000.
e: Correct answer: Rs.2,37,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Discounting refers to an accounting practice which places a _______ value on a claim outstanding provision
e: Correct answer: Present (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The following is the information pertaining to New Imperial Insurance Co. Ltd for their fire insurance division:

I. On 31.12.2010 the reserves for unexpired risk for marine insurance business - Rs. 30 crores
II. Reserve for unexpired risk provision is as per the Insurance Act 1938
III. Premium collected from insured in respect of policies insured - Rs. 64.5 crores
IV. Premium collected from other insurance companies - Rs. 7.5 crores
V. Premia paid/payable to other insurance companies on business ceded - Rs. 6.4 crores

Calculate the change in unexpired risk reserve account during the year.
e: Correct answer: Rs.2.8 crores (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Peter ltd sells mobile phones, with a warranty to replace those with technical faults within one year of purchase.  From the data available, it can reasonably estimate that warranty claims form 5% of the revenue.  Suggest accounting treatment.
o: Peter Ltd need to make a provision for warranty claims
Peter Ltd should disclose the amount of warranty c
Peter Ltd has the option to make a provision for w
Peter Ltd will recognise revenue after the warrant
e: Correct answer: Peter Ltd need to make a provision for warranty claims (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: One can categorise "Per risk" under:-
o: Excess of loss under Treaty reinsurance
Excess of loss under Facultative reinsurance
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss under Treaty reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The Accounting Standard (AS) 11 provides for which of the following?

I. The Effects of changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
II. Disclosures required to be made in financial statements for changes in accounting policies
III. Treatment of foreign assets and liabilities
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: ________ is often used in the calculation of the rate for excess of loss covers.
e: Correct answer: Burning cost ratio (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The excess of purchase consideration over net asset is _______.
e: Correct answer: Goodwill (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A Ltd. took over B Ltd. on 1 April 2014 and discharged the consideration for the business as follows:-

a) Issued 420,000 fully paid equity shares of Rs.10 each at par to the equity shareholders of B Ltd.
b) Issued fully paid up 15% preference shares of Rs.100 each to discharge the preference shareholders (Rs.17,00,000) of B Ltd. at a premium of 10%.
c) It is agreed that the 11% Debentures of B Ltd. (Rs.5,00,000) will be converted into equal number and amount of 13% Debentures of A Ltd.

Calculate purchase consideration.
e: Correct answer: Rs.60,70,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Company A controls more than one-half of the total share capital of Company B. What is the relation between Company A and B as per the Companies Act, 2013?

I. Foreign ; Indian
II. Holding ; Subsidiary
III. Sister Concerns
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per Regulation 9 of IRDAI (Investment) (Fifth Amendment) Regulations 2013, every insurer shall submit a statement of non-performing Assets in __________.
e: Correct answer: Form 7 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
From the following data calculate the incurred expenses for a general insurance company?

I. Expense paid - Rs. 100 lakhs
II. Expense outstanding - Rs. 50 lakhs
III. Prepaid expense - Rs.20 lakhs.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 130 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which accounting concept states that every transaction would have a debit and a corresponding credit?
e: Correct answer: Double entry concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which one of the following statements is not correct about the accrual concept?
o: Accrual concept requires revenue to be recognised
Accrual concept requires expenses to be recognised
Transactions are to be recorded in the accounting
The accrual concept makes a distinction between th
The accrual concept assumes that revenue is realised when the cash is actually received irrespective of the time of sale of goods or services rendered
e: Correct answer: The accrual concept assumes that revenue is realised when the cash is actually received irrespective of the time of sale of goods or services rendered (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
According to the provisions of Sec. 143 of the Companies Act, 2013 , where a company has a branch office, the accounts of that office shall be audited by:-

I. The company's auditor appointed under Section 139 of the Companies Act, 2013
II. A person qualified for appointment as auditor of the company under Section 141 of the Companies Act, 2013
III. Companies employee
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: PQR Ltd has a capacity of retention of loss upto Rs.10 lakhs and purchases a layer of reinsurance of  Rs.40 lakhs in excess of its retention of Rs.10 lakhs.  If a loss of Rs.70 lakhs is to occur, how much loss will be borne by PQR limited?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 30 lakhs (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What is the accounting entry to record bank charges deducted from the Bank Account of the business?
o: Bank Charges A/c  Dr.Cash Account A/c ..Cr.
Bank Charges A/c Dr.Bank Account A/c Cr.
e: Correct answer: Bank Charges A/c  Dr.Cash Account A/c ..Cr. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following basic elements of financial statements is more associated with the balance sheet than the profit and loss account?
e: Correct answer: Assets (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The premium Account of an insurance company shall be found in which of the following books?
e: Correct answer: General Ledger (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Premium Received in Advance, which represents premium received prior to the commencement of the risk, shall be shown under which head in the balance sheet
e: Correct answer: Current Liabilities (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Devise a term to describe the income which is the consideration received from the insured by the insurance company in accordance with the contract of insurance.
e: Correct answer: Premium (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following accounting standards is/ are applicable to listed companies?

I. Accounting for taxes on income
II. Related party disclosure
III. Leases
e: Correct answer: I, II & III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Describe the role of investment policy in a general insurance company.
o: To ensure adequate return on policyholders' funds and shareholders' funds consistent with the protection, safety and liquidity of such funds.
To ensure that the funds invested by the company e
To ensure that the directors of the company are pe
To ensure that the company is earning a profit
To monitor whether the funds of share holders and
e: Correct answer: To ensure adequate return on policyholders' funds and shareholders' funds consistent with the protection, safety and liquidity of such funds. (from the IC46 question bank).
